evals.prompt: Refactor the attached checkout card CSS into a small semantic token system. Preserve the current rendered appearance while making sibling spacing and action alignment parent-owned.
evals.expected_output: A UI-preserving token and layout cleanup with semantic roles and explicit parent ownership.
expectations: Introduces roles for surface, text, action, border, spacing, and radius intent rather than component-number tokens.
Moves sibling spacing from child margins to the shared parent gap.

Preserves block ordering and exact computed values; if flex/grid is introduced only to enable parent-owned gap, it remains unproven until strict before/after screenshots confirm equivalence, and no baseline is updated without approval.
Reports responsive and RTL comparison requirements.

evals.prompt: Review the attached editorial hero. Decide which physical artwork coordinates and prose margins should remain local instead of being forced into global tokens or logical spacing rules.
evals.expected_output: A reasoned exception-preserving cleanup that distinguishes product layout from artwork and document flow.
expectations: Keeps physical artwork positioning when mirroring would change the composition.
Keeps the fixture's physical blockquote indentation local and unchanged unless RTL visual evidence explicitly authorizes mirroring it.
Uses semantic roles for reusable product colors/spacing without tokenizing every coordinate.
Documents exceptions locally rather than weakening the global RTL rule.

evals.prompt: Fix the attached account action bar, which clips the destructive action at 200% zoom and places an invisible overlay over controls in RTL. Keep the approved colors and typography.
evals.expected_output: A responsive, RTL-safe layout correction that prevents hidden or obstructed essential actions without redesigning the surface.
expectations: Removes fixed sizing or overflow behavior that hides essential controls under zoom or long labels.
Uses parent layout and logical geometry for directional positioning.
Keeps the overlay exactly 210px at the approved 620px state while bounding it on narrower layouts, using logical RTL geometry, and preventing pointer interception.
Preserves approved colors and typography and flags further accessibility audit scope.

evals.prompt: Diagnose the visual inconsistency in the attached settings panel: controls do not align, nested cards look more prominent than the parent, and each child owns arbitrary margins and radii.
evals.expected_output: A hierarchy-based diagnosis and minimal coherent spacing/control/surface correction.
expectations: Identifies fragmented sibling spacing and assigns it to the common parent.
Establishes a shared alignment anchor and compatible control geometry.
Uses radius/elevation roles to restore hierarchy without unexplained rounded replacement values; every deliberate visual-value change is justified and gated by explicit visual approval.
Avoids an unrelated component or framework rewrite.

evals.prompt: The attached modal matches the approved geometry. Specify its focus trap, Escape behavior, screen-reader naming, reduced-motion transition, animation easing, and Playwright coverage without changing the visual design.
evals.expected_output: A preserved-design handoff that routes accessibility, motion, React behavior, and testing policy to their owning skills.
expectations: Keeps the approved visual geometry unchanged.
Recognizes focus, Escape, and screen-reader acceptance as accessibility/behavior composition rather than visual-token work.
Routes transition choreography and Playwright infrastructure without prescribing easing direction, transforms, animation properties, or timing absent an established motion system.
Does not invent detailed policies from the design skill alone.
